ja: 魔物[まもの]を見[み]**た**
en: I saw a monster; Plain past ending saying the action already happened.

ja: 俺[おれ]は行[い]か**ない**
en: I am not going; Plain negative ending which then inflects like an adjective.

ja: 話[はなし]を聞[き]い**て**
en: Listen to me; Linking ending that joins verbs or softens an order into a request.

ja: 魔王[まおう]が待[ま]っ**ている**
en: The demon lord is waiting; Ending for an action in progress or a state that still holds.

ja: 私[わたし]が行[い]き**ます**
en: I will go; Polite ending used with strangers and with anyone above you.

ja: 何[なに]も知[し]り**ません**
en: I do not know anything; Polite negative ending for the same audience that gets the polite ending.

ja: 何[なに]も言[い]わ**なかった**
en: He said nothing; Plain past negative built by putting the negative into the past.

ja: 話[はなし]を聞[き]**け**
en: Listen; Bare command ending on a five step verb and it sounds harsh.

ja: これを見[み]**ろ**
en: Look at this; Bare command ending on a one step verb.

ja: そこへ行[い]く**な**
en: Do not go there; Particle after the plain form that flatly forbids the action.

ja: 魔王[まおう]に会[あ]い**たい**
en: I want to meet the demon lord; Ending for your own desire and never for what someone else wants.

ja: 一緒[いっしょ]に行[い]**こう**
en: Let us go together; Ending proposing that we act or announcing that you intend to.

ja: 助[たす]け**てくれ**
en: Help me; Ending asking the listener to act for your benefit.

ja: 一人[ひとり]で行[い]**ける**
en: I can go alone; Ending on a five step verb saying the action is possible.

ja: 私[わたし]は食[た]べ**られる**
en: I can eat that; Ending on a one step verb saying the action is possible.

ja: みんなに言[い]わ**れた**
en: Everyone told me so; Ending marking the subject as the one acted upon.

ja: 部下[ぶか]を行[い]か**せる**
en: I will send my men; Ending for making or letting someone else do the action.

ja: 私[わたし]に行[い]か**せて**
en: Let me go; Ending asking permission to be the one who acts.

ja: 行[い]け**ば**分[わ]かる
en: You will understand if you go; Ending for a general condition where the second part follows the first.

ja: 来[き]**たら**教[おし]えてくれ
en: Tell me once he arrives; Ending for after something happens and it can also mean if.

ja: 敵[てき]は強[つよ]**かった**
en: The enemy was strong; Past ending for adjectives which never take the verb past.

ja: あいつは強[つよ]**くない**
en: He is not strong; Negative ending for adjectives.

ja: 早[はや]**く**行[い]く
en: I will go quickly; Ending turning an adjective into how the action is done.

ja: 本当[ほんとう]**に**強[つよ]い
en: He is really strong; Ending that turns an adjective taking na into how or how much something is done.

ja: あれは魔王[まおう]**だった**
en: That was the demon lord; Past of the plain copula which nouns need since they cannot inflect.

ja: 俺[おれ]が行[い]く**んだ**
en: I am the one who is going; Ending framing the sentence as the explanation behind something.

ja: あいつは来[く]る**だろう**
en: He will probably come; Ending for a guess you are fairly confident about.

ja: ここで死[し]ぬ**かもしれない**
en: I might die here; Ending for a possibility you cannot rule out.

ja: 全部[ぜんぶ]食[た]べ**てしまった**
en: I ate the lot; Ending for finishing something off and often for regretting it.

ja: 先[さき]に話[はな]し**ておく**
en: I will tell them beforehand; Ending for acting in advance and leaving the result in place.

ja: 食[た]べ**てみる**
en: I will give it a taste; Ending for doing something to find out how it goes.

ja: もう帰[かえ]っ**てもいい**
en: You may go home now; Ending granting permission to act.

ja: 早[はや]く行[い]か**なきゃ**
en: I have to go now; Casual contraction saying you have no choice but to act.

ja: 食[た]べ**ながら**話[はな]す
en: He talks while eating; Ending for doing this at the same time as the main action.

ja: 魔王[まおう]に会[あ]っ**たことがある**
en: I have met a demon lord; Pattern for having done something at least once in your life.

ja: あいつは強[つよ]**そう**だ
en: He looks strong; Ending for a judgement made from appearances alone.

ja: お前[まえ]は強[つよ]**すぎる**
en: You are too strong; Ending saying the quality goes past what is right.
